description: This file manages logging configuration and behavior for the Matrix SDK client, including setting log modes, creating loggers, and suppressing specific error messages.

methods.name: shouldSuppressMatrixHttpNotFound
methods.description: Determines if a message related to 'MatrixHttpClient' should be suppressed based on error code 'M_NOT_FOUND'.

methods.name: ensureMatrixSdkLoggingConfigured
methods.description: Configures logging for the Matrix SDK if not already configured.

methods.name: setMatrixSdkLogMode
methods.description: Sets the logging mode to 'default' or 'quiet' and applies the logger configuration.

methods.name: setMatrixSdkConsoleLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables console logging via an external logger.

methods.name: createMatrixJsSdkClientLogger
methods.description: Creates a new logger instance with a specified prefix.

methods.name: applyMatrixJsSdkRootLoggerMode
methods.description: Adjusts the root logger's method factory based on the current log mode.

methods.name: applyMatrixSdkLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger for LogService based on the current log mode, with suppression for specific errors.

methods.name: createMatrixJsSdkLoggerInstance
methods.description: Creates a logger instance with methods for trace, debug, info, warn, error, and getChild.
